summary_en: This study tests venetoclax given with obinutuzumab or with acalabrutinib for adults with previously untreated chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), a cancer of blood cells. Venetoclax is taken as a tablet by mouth; obinutuzumab is given as an intravenous infusion; acalabrutinib is taken as a tablet by mouth. Some arms use a 5-week venetoclax ramp-up, and the total study duration is about 28 months. The study measures safety, including side effects, and change in disease activity; the record lists the phase as Phase 3.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa venetoclax combinado con obinutuzumab o con acalabrutinib para adultos con leucemia linfocítica crónica (LLC) no tratada previamente, un cáncer de las células sanguíneas. El venetoclax se toma en tableta por vía oral; el obinutuzumab se administra como infusión intravenosa; el acalabrutinib se toma en tableta por vía oral. Algunos grupos usan un periodo de ajuste gradual de venetoclax de 5 semanas, y la duración total del estudio es de unos 28 meses. El estudio mide la seguridad, incluidos los efectos secundarios, y el cambio en la actividad de la enfermedad; el registro indica que es un estudio de Fase 3.
who_for: Previously untreated chronic lymphocytic leukemia that needs treatment by 2018 iwCLL criteria.
ECOG performance status of 2 or lower.
Creatinine clearance of 30 mL/min or higher by Cockcroft-Gault formula.
